title: Diff Viewer
tagline: A code and data diff viewer for React, with an IDE-grade review experience.
highlights: Side-by-side, inline and unified views with word-level highlighting and IDE-style change connectors
Command palette, line links, merge arrows, search, folding and an overview ruler
JSON & CSV structural diffs with ignored paths and keyed array or row matching
Framework-free comparison engine for Node, workers and CLIs; highlight.js or Shiki highlighting
